name: Aim Charm
notes: Aim Charm: +5 accuracy points for the player's moves, up to 4 times (+20: a 90% move never misses). Adds 5 to boost_aim. Offered on the waves mode's level-up menu (menu_power); its level is kept in 'up_aim' (back to 0 each run).
title: AIM CHARM
